page.overview:
Who is Erythiona and Viracheios?

Erythiona and Viracheios are two members of the coven of Isharnai, the Prism Sage.

Erythiona was an old woman of fey elven features, with burning red eyes, bull-like horns framed by vibrant orange hair, and numerous tattoos. She wore an armor made of leather and leaves.

Viracheios was a frail and corpse-like woman with long white hair and pale skin and eyes, surrounded by cold, pale energy. She wore a tight shroud-like dress without sleeves.

During their imprisonment each of the witches had a different attitude, with Erythiona being critical and Viracheios being more contemptuous.
